LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.0.label: Keep Watch
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.0.descripti: Retains the chosen Guardian evolution. Refinement: retaliation damage or sanctuary shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.1.label: Brace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.1.descripti: After your shield actually absorbs enemy damage, remember that attacker for 4 seconds. An ordinary hit on that enemy deals 50 extra damage once. Trigger cooldown: 4 seconds. Waiting neither changes the target nor renews the window. Reflection, abilities and bonus damage cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.2.label: Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.2.descripti: An ordinary hit grants a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds to the other colonist within 3 cells of you who is closest to the victim. That ally must also be within 6 cells of the victim. Cooldown: 5 seconds; no eligible ally spends no cooldown. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.3.label: Behind the Shield
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.3.descripti: Within 3 seconds after Brace deals actual bonus damage, another ordinary hit on the same enemy deals 50 extra damage once. Fresh Brace damage cannot replace an unexpired opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.4.label: Yield the Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.4.descripti: Within 3 seconds after Brace deals actual bonus damage, walk at least one cell away from your position at that trigger and ordinarily hit a different enemy for a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels the opportunity. Fresh Brace damage cannot reset the round while pending or for 3 seconds after the shield grant. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.5.label: Call the Target
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.5.descripti: When a Cover shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original recipient has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit that attacker for 50 extra damage once, attributed to the shield author. The author and other allies cannot claim it. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.6.label: Cover the Return
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.6.descripti: Within 3 seconds after a Cover shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original recipient walks at least one cell closer to the author and ordinarily hits an enemy within 2 cells of the author to mend up to 20 points of their own non-permanent injury, once. Teleporting cancels it; scars are excluded. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.7.label: Open the Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.7.descripti: Actual Behind the Shield damage leaves a 3-second opening on that enemy. The first other colonist to ordinarily hit it deals 50 extra damage attributed to the original author, once. The author cannot claim it; waiting neither changes the victim nor extends the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.8.label: Cross the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.8.descripti: Within 3 seconds after the Yield the Edge shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, walk at least one further cell and ordinarily hit a different enemy from that attacker for 50 extra damage, once. Teleporting cancels it; later absorption cannot change the attacker or renew the window. A new Yield the Edge shield cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.9.label: Close In
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.9.descripti: After the original ally deals actual Call the Target damage, the author has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit the same enemy and deal 50 damage to the nearest other enemy within 3 cells, once. No second enemy retains the opportunity without extending it. Fresh Call the Target damage cannot replace a pending opportunity. This bonus cannot generate Cover. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.10.label: Form Up Again
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.10.descript: After Cover the Return actually heals, the author has 3 seconds to ordinarily hit a different enemy and grant the original patient a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds, once. The patient must be within 4 cells and is never replaced. This shield does not trigger Cover branch absorption rewards. Further return healing cannot reset this round while the opportunity or its granted shield remains active. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.11.label: Press the Breach
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.11.descript: Within 3 seconds after an ally actually claims Open the Guard, your ordinary hit on a different enemy deals 50 extra damage to the original opening victim, once. That victim must remain within 6 cells of you. An unavailable victim retains the opportunity without extending it and is never replaced. Fresh openings cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.12.label: Shields Together
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.12.descript: Within 3 seconds after an ally actually claims Open the Guard, walk at least one cell closer to that ally and ordinarily hit an enemy while you are within 2 cells of them to grant both of you a separate 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once. Teleporting cancels it; fresh openings cannot replace a pending opportunity. If either old Shields Together layer remains, the opportunity waits without extension. Refinement: each recipient's separate shield strength. Base rewards: shield 25. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.13.label: Cut Off
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.13.descript: Within 3 seconds after Cross the Line deals actual damage, walk at least one further cell closer to its victim and ordinarily hit it for 50 extra damage, once. Victim movement does not reset your walking origin. Teleporting cancels it. Fresh Cross the Line damage cannot replace a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.14.label: Turn Back
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.14.descript: Within 3 seconds after Cross the Line deals actual damage, walk back within 1 cell of the original Yield the Edge position and ordinarily hit an enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 3 cells, once. Teleporting cancels it. Scars are excluded; no patient does not extend the window. Fresh Cross the Line damage cannot replace a pending opportunity or its original Yield the Edge position. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.15.label: From Both Sides
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.15.descript: Within 3 seconds after Close In actually damages the secondary victim, the original Call the Target ally can ordinarily hit that victim for 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once. No other pawn can claim it; the bonus cannot trigger Close In again. Fresh Close In damage cannot replace the pending victim, ally or deadline. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.16.label: Room to Breathe
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.16.descript: Within 3 seconds after Close In actually damages the secondary victim, the author can ordinarily hit a different enemy to grant the original Call the Target ally within 4 cells a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once. This shield cannot trigger Cover rewards and the original ally is never replaced. Fresh Close In damage cannot replace a pending opportunity or an active shield source. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.17.label: Back to the Front
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.17.descript: Within 3 seconds after the Form Up Again shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, its original patient takes at least one new walking step and, outside the author’s 2-cell area, hits that attacker with a normal attack for 50 extra damage attributed to the author, once. Teleporting cancels it; later absorption does not renew the window. A fresh shield round cannot replace the original ally or attacker of a pending opportunity. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.18.label: Aid in Reserve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Guardian.nodes.18.descript: Within 3 seconds after the Form Up Again shield first actually absorbs enemy damage, the author ordinarily hits a different enemy to mend up to 20 points on the most non-permanently injured other colonist within 3 cells of the original patient, once. Excludes the author and original patient. No patient retains the deadline; scars are excluded. Later absorption does not renew it, and a fresh shield round cannot replace the original patient or attacker of a pending opportunity. Refinement: non-permanent injury healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
